The audit reached the same reading independently (T3, IMPORTANT, deliberately not fixed — a demo-lane re-record is not a surgical audit edit) and handed the call to the evaluator. Session precedent applied: iter-7 ('a condition that is verifiably false today is unmet, however well disclosed') and iter-9 ('the correct evidence is reachable TODAY with zero code change' — here the exact fixture-scoped rig with three checkpoint runs existed hours ago in this same iteration and its recipe is scripted).
